title: Kvasier Drink
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to the side areas of the 3rd and 4th levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Divine Orok Runts to collect 25 Runt Currants kill Divine Orok Shamans for 15 Divine Drums. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the side areas of the 3rd and 4th levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Divine Orok Runts to collect 25 Runt Currants kill Divine Orok Shamans for 15 Divine Drums. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

You certainly are most thirsty my apprentice. You are showing such a passion and interest in my craft, but I can't help but to wonder where all this liquid is going. You can pollute the gene pool, just be sure not to pollute the streams.

Anytime you want Khodebshchik to make you another Kvasier, bring me fifteen Divine Drums and twenty-five Runt Currants to to Ratsputin's Holding Cell, and I'll mix it up for you.

Turn-in:

I still say that you are working too hard. You are my apprentice now. Take it easy. While you are taking it easy, take this drink and do something with it.

Objectives:

  • Runt Currants ×25
  • Divine Drums ×15

Client level range: 75–95
